mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_order_list( user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, start_time, end_time, goods_id, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, request_team_id, notify_url, status, out_trade_time, out_trade_no, biz_id, create_time, update_time ) select #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{orderId}, #{activityId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{goodsId}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalPrice}, #{deductionPrice}, #{payPrice}, #{requestTeamId}, #{notifyUrl}, #{status}, #{outTradeTime}, #{outTradeNo}, #{bizId}, now(), now() from group_buy_order where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 0 and valid_start_time <= now(3) and now(3) < valid_end_time and #{startTime} <= now(3) and now(3) < #{endTime}
mapper.select: select user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, start_time, end_time, goods_id, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, status from group_buy_order_list where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0
select * from group_buy_order_list where source=#{source} and channel=#{channel} and out_trade_no=#{outTradeNo}
select count(id) from group_buy_order_list where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.update: update group_buy_order_list set status = 1, out_trade_time = #{outTradeTime}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and source = #{source} and channel = #{channel} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0
mapper.select: select out_trade_no from group_buy_order_list where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 1

select l.user_id, l.team_id, l.out_trade_no from group_buy_order_list l join group_buy_order t on t.team_id=l.team_id where l.activity_id=#{activityId} and l.user_id=#{userId} and binary l.user_id=binary #{userId} and l.status in (0,1) and t.status=0 and t.valid_start_time <= now(3) and now(3) < t.valid_end_time order by l.id desc limit #{count}

select t.team_id from group_buy_order t where t.activity_id=#{activityId} and t.status=0 and t.lock_count < t.target_count and t.valid_start_time <= now(3) and now(3) < t.valid_end_time and exists (select 1 from group_buy_order_list l where l.team_id=t.team_id and l.status in (0,1)) and not exists (select 1 from group_buy_order_list mine where mine.team_id=t.team_id and mine.user_id=#{userId} and binary mine.user_id=binary #{userId}) order by t.create_time desc, t.id desc limit #{count}

select t1.user_id, t1.team_id, t1.out_trade_no from group_buy_order_list t1 inner join ( select min(id) as id from group_buy_order_list where activity_id = #{activityId} and status in (0, 1) group by team_id ) t2 on t1.id = t2.id
